Fact.Name: Massachusetts personal exemption, single
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 2a for a single filer. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(b)(1)(A): "The personal exemption shall not exceed $4,400." 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 2a: "If you are single or married filing a separate return, enter $4,400 in line 2a." Married filing separately is not in scope.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts personal exemption, married filing jointly
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 2a for a joint return. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(b)(2)(A): "The personal exemption shall not exceed $8,800." 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 2a: "If married filing a joint return, enter $8,800 in line 2a."

Fact.Name: Massachusetts Part B income tax rate
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 22. 2025 Form 1 instructions, revised August 4, 2026: "If line 21 is greater than $24,000 multiply by 0.05 and enter the result in line 22." M.G.L. c. 62, § 4(b) taxes Part B income at 5.3 per cent and then reduces that rate, and says "Part B taxable income shall be taxed at a rate of not less than 5 per cent." The filled rate is that 5 percent floor, stored as 1/20. The amount is rounded once, half up, to the dollar.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts optional 5.85 percent rate
Fact.Description: 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 22: "Personal income tax forms must provide an election to voluntarily pay tax at a rate of 5.85% on taxable income which would otherwise be taxed at a rate of 5.0%." "If choosing the optional 5.85% tax rate, multiply line 21 and Schedule D, line 21 by 0.0585 and fill in the oval." Schedule D is out of scope. Stored as 585/10000, which is 0.0585. This election is not in M.G.L. c. 62, § 4.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts Social Security, Medicare, and retirement deduction cap
Fact.Description: Form 1 lines 11a and 11b. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(a)(3) deducts FICA and railroad retirement taxes, and the aggregate with retirement-fund contributions "attributable to any one taxpayer" shall not "exceed two thousand dollars." 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 11: enter the amount paid "but not more than $2,000 each." The cap is per person. The two spouses are not combined.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts rental deduction cap
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 14. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(a)(9): "an amount equal to 50 per cent of such rent; provided, however, that such deduction shall not exceed $4,000 for a single person, for a person that qualifies as a head of household under section two (b) of the Code, or for a husband and wife." 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 14: enter half of line 14a, "or $4,000 ($2,000 if married filing a separate return), whichever is smaller." Married filing separately is not in scope, so the cap on a supported return is $4,000.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts tax table threshold
Fact.Description: 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 22: "If line 21 is less than $24,000, find the proper tax by using the tax tables found in the back of this booklet. If line 21 is greater than $24,000 multiply by 0.05." The tax table, No Tax Status, and the Limited Income Credit are not calculated. A return stops when line 21 is less than $24,000. Exactly $24,000 is 5 percent of an exact $1,200, so it is computed. The same threshold covers No Tax Status and the Limited Income Credit, because those income limits leave line 21 under $24,000 after the exemptions in scope.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts 4 percent surtax stop
Fact.Description: M.G.L. c. 62, § 4(d): where the sum of Part A, Part B, and Part C taxable income "exceeds $1,000,000 in a taxable year, the portion of such taxable income exceeding $1,000,000 shall be taxed" at the Part A, B, and C rates "plus an additional 4 per cent." The threshold is adjusted for the cost of living. 2025 Form 1 instructions: the 2025 threshold is $1,083,150. The 2026 indexed figure is not pinned, so a return stops when line 21 is greater than $1,000,000. Exactly $1,000,000 has no portion exceeding the statutory base, so it is computed at 5 percent with no surtax.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts residency answers
Fact.Description: Full-year resident is the supported Form 1. Part-year residents and nonresidents use Form 1-NR/PY. A joint return is a full-year Form 1 only when both spouses lived in Massachusetts all year.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts residency
Fact.Description: Full year means you, and your spouse if you file jointly, lived in Massachusetts all year. Part-year and nonresident stop. Form 1 and Form 1-NR/PY.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts residency is part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: True for Form 1-NR/PY. Incomplete until /maResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Qualified Massachusetts rent paid
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 14a. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 14: "Enter the total amount of qualified rent paid by you during 2025 in line 14a." Incomplete until answered, so line 14 is not treated as zero on a return that has not been asked.

Fact.Name: Elects the optional 5.85 percent rate
Fact.Description: 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 22, require an election to pay 5.85 percent instead of 5.0 percent. The default is no, which fills line 22 at 5 percent and leaves the oval blank. Yes multiplies line 21 by 0.0585 and fills the oval.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts use tax owed
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 34, use tax due on internet, mail order, and other out-of-state purchases. The worksheet is not calculated. Yes stops the return. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Full-year minimum creditable coverage
Fact.Description: M.G.L. c. 111M, § 2(b): every resident filer shall indicate whether the person "had creditable coverage in force for each of the 12 months of the taxable year." Schedule HC is required with a resident Form 1. No stops the return. The penalty worksheet is not calculated. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Spouse full-year minimum creditable coverage
Fact.Description: The same M.G.L. c. 111M, § 2(b) indication for the spouse on a joint return. Asked only on a joint return. No stops the return.

Fact.Name: Massachusetts retirement contribution in W-2 box 14
Fact.Description: A contribution to a U.S. or Massachusetts retirement system shown in W-2 box 14 changes lines 11a and 11b. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(a)(3) and (4) cap those contributions together with FICA at two thousand dollars per taxpayer. This return uses boxes 4 and 6 only, so yes stops the return. Incomplete until answered.

Fact.Name: Insurer on Form MA 1099-HC
Fact.Description: Schedule HC line 4f, the name of the private insurer or program from Form MA 1099-HC box 1. Filled on a supported full-year resident return.

Fact.Name: Subscriber or member number on Form MA 1099-HC
Fact.Description: Schedule HC line 4f, the subscriber number from Form MA 1099-HC, or the identification number on the health insurance card when no 1099-HC was issued.

Fact.Name: Spouse's insurer on Form MA 1099-HC
Fact.Description: Schedule HC line 4g for the spouse on a joint return.

Fact.Name: Spouse's subscriber or member number on Form MA 1099-HC
Fact.Description: Schedule HC line 4g subscriber number for the spouse on a joint return.

Fact.Name: Ask the spouse Massachusetts questions
Fact.Description: Spouse coverage, and the spouse lines on Schedule HC, are on a joint Form 1. A single return does not wait on them.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 2a personal exemption
Fact.Description: $4,400 single or $8,800 joint. Other filing statuses are not this amount; those returns stop, and this fact is zero for them so the exemption is not a supported number.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 2g total exemptions
Fact.Description: Add lines 2a through 2f. Lines 2b through 2f are zero in scope, so this equals line 2a. It is also entered on line 18.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 3 Massachusetts wages
Fact.Description: 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 3: "Report in line 3 total state wages and allocated tips from Form(s) W-2." This is the sum of W-2 box 16. A blank box 15 is in scope and its box 16 is included. Massachusetts does not adopt IRC section 224 or 225, and line 3 is not federal AGI, so a federal Schedule 1-A deduction does not change this line and is not a stop.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10 total 5.0 percent income
Fact.Description: Add lines 3 through 9. Lines 4 through 9 are zero in scope, so this equals line 3.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Social Security and Medicare tax
Fact.Description: Box 4 plus box 6. Lines 11a and 11b use this amount, not a retirement amount from box 14. A blank box 4 or box 6 is zero.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Social Security and Medicare tax for the primary filer
Fact.Description: Box 4 plus box 6 when the W-2 belongs to the primary filer, otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Social Security and Medicare tax for the spouse
Fact.Description: Box 4 plus box 6 when the W-2 belongs to the spouse. Used only on a joint return, so a single return does not wait on the spouse.

Fact.Name: Primary filer's Social Security and Medicare tax
Fact.Description: Sum of box 4 and box 6 on the primary filer's W-2s, before the $2,000 cap.

Fact.Name: Spouse's Social Security and Medicare tax
Fact.Description: Sum of box 4 and box 6 on the spouse's W-2s, before the $2,000 cap. Zero when the return is not joint.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 11a
Fact.Description: Primary filer's box 4 plus box 6, not more than $2,000. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 11.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 11b
Fact.Description: Spouse's box 4 plus box 6, not more than $2,000, on a joint return. Zero on a single return. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 11.

Fact.Name: Half of qualified rent, whole dollars
Fact.Description: Line 14a divided by 2, rounded half-up to the dollar. The form uses the whole-dollar method. The specified test rents divide evenly.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 14 rental deduction
Fact.Description: The smaller of half the qualified rent and $4,000. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 14. M.G.L. c. 62, § 3B(a)(9).

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 15 Schedule Y
Fact.Description: Other deductions from Schedule Y are zero in scope. The 2025 form has no lines 12 or 13. Line 16 is the sum of lines 11 through 15, which in scope is line 11a plus line 11b plus line 14.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 16 total deductions
Fact.Description: Add lines 11 through 15. In scope that is line 11a plus line 11b plus line 14.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 17 5.0 percent income after deductions
Fact.Description: Subtract line 16 from line 10. Not less than 0. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 17.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 18 exemption amount
Fact.Description: From line 2g.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 19 5.0 percent income after exemptions
Fact.Description: Subtract line 18 from line 17. Not less than 0. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 19.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 20 interest and dividend income
Fact.Description: Schedule B interest and dividend income is zero in scope. That income stops the return.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 21 total taxable 5.0 percent income
Fact.Description: Add lines 19 and 20. Line 20 is zero in scope, so this equals line 19.

Fact.Name: Rate applied on Form 1 line 22
Fact.Description: 5.85 percent when the optional rate is elected, otherwise 5 percent.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 22 after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round(line 21 times the applied rate). Dollar times Rational scales to cents half-even before Round half-up, so a product whose exact fraction is just under half a dollar can become 50 cents and then round up a dollar. This is not the amount entered on the form.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact Form 1 line 22
Fact.Description: Line 21 times 5 at 5 percent, or line 21 times 117/20 at 5.85 percent. That is 100 times the exact tax, and for a whole-dollar line 21 it is exact to the cent. 49,610 times 5 is 248,050 cents, which is 2,480.50 dollars. 127,200 times 117/20 is 744,120 cents, which is 7,441.20 dollars.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 22 tax
Fact.Description: Line 21 times 5 percent, or 5.85 percent when elected, rounded once, half up, to the dollar. The cent-then-dollar result is one dollar high when it exceeds this exact product by more than 50 cents. An exact half dollar, 2,480.50, stays 2,481. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 22. M.G.L. c. 62, § 4(b).

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 28a income tax
Fact.Description: Add lines 22 through 26. Lines 23 through 26 are zero in scope, so this equals line 22.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 28 total tax
Fact.Description: Line 28a plus line 28b. The 4 percent surtax is zero because a return over $1,000,000 stops. This equals line 28a.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 32 income tax after credits
Fact.Description: Line 28 minus lines 29 through 31, not less than zero. Those credits are zero. The Massachusetts EITC is not calculated; a federal earned income credit greater than zero stops the return. This equals line 28.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 33 voluntary contributions
Fact.Description: Voluntary fund contributions are zero because the line is not offered. The return does not ask for a contribution.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 34 use tax
Fact.Description: Zero. Any use tax owed stops the return.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 35 health care penalty
Fact.Description: Zero. A filer without full-year minimum creditable coverage stops the return, so the penalty worksheet is not calculated. Schedule HC is still enclosed for a supported return.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 37 tax after credits, contributions, use tax, and penalty
Fact.Description: Add lines 32 through 36. Lines 33 through 36 are zero, so this equals line 32, which equals the line 22 tax.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Massachusetts withholding
Fact.Description: Box 17 when box 15 is Massachusetts (the same state as the residence). A blank box 15 is in scope and contributes zero. A box 15 for another state stops the return and contributes zero here.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 38a Massachusetts income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Sum of W-2 box 17 where box 15 is Massachusetts. 2025 Form 1, line 38a.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 38 total Massachusetts income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Add lines 38a through 38c. Lines 38b and 38c are zero, so this equals line 38a.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 51 total payments and credits
Fact.Description: Add lines 38 through 42 and lines 48 through 50. Estimated payments, the extension, and the refundable credits are zero, so this equals line 38.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 52 overpayment
Fact.Description: Line 51 minus line 37 when line 51 is larger, otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 54 refund
Fact.Description: Line 52 minus line 53. Nothing is applied to next year's estimated tax, so the refund equals line 52.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 55 tax due
Fact.Description: Line 37 minus line 51 when line 37 is larger, otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: Form 1 zero
Fact.Description: Printed on lines this return does not calculate. Dependents, age 65, blindness, Schedule Y, Schedule B, credits, use tax, the health care penalty, and voluntary contributions are zero because those cases stop or the line is not offered.

Fact.Name: Federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Interest, including Massachusetts bank interest on Form 1 line 5, dividends and other Schedule B income, tax-exempt interest, Social Security, a sale or capital gain, 1099-MISC, a 1099-R, Schedule C, or Schedule E. Any of that income stops a Form 1. Adjustments that reduce AGI are not this stop. Massachusetts bank interest and Schedule B amounts are interest or dividends on the federal return.

Fact.Name: Dependents or a qualifying person
Fact.Description: Anyone in the household, including a dependent, or a filer who is a qualifying person for the child and dependent care credit. Form 1 lines 2b, 2f, and the dependent credits are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Primary filer is 65 or older or blind. On a joint return, either spouse. Form 1 lines 2c and 2d are not calculated. The spouse is checked only on a joint return so a single return does not wait on the spouse.

Fact.Name: Filing status other than single or joint
Fact.Description: The supported Form 1 is single, or married filing jointly with both spouses in Massachusetts all year. Head of household, married filing separately, and qualifying surviving spouse are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 21 is under $24,000
Fact.Description: The tax table, No Tax Status, and the Limited Income Credit. Less than $24,000 stops. Exactly $24,000 does not.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 21 is over $1,000,000
Fact.Description: The 4 percent surtax. Greater than $1,000,000 stops. Exactly $1,000,000 does not.

Fact.Name: Federal earned income credit is greater than zero
Fact.Description: The Massachusetts earned income credit is not calculated. A federal earned income credit greater than zero stops the return.

Fact.Name: Schedule HC insurer and subscriber number are entered
Fact.Description: A supported resident Form 1 fills Schedule HC Part 1 and the insurer name and subscriber number from Form MA 1099-HC. Incomplete until both are entered and not blank. On a joint return, the spouse's name and number are required too. This is not a yes stop. It keeps the form from being printed with those lines blank.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Massachusetts part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Form 1-NR/PY is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. Incomplete until /maResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: a W-2 box 15 is not Massachusetts
Fact.Description: Any W-2 whose box 15 is a state other than Massachusetts. A blank box 15 is in scope and is not this stop. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Any federal income other than W-2 wages, including Massachusetts bank interest and Schedule B. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: dependents or a qualifying person
Fact.Description: Lines 2b and the dependent credits are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Lines 2c and 2d are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: filing status other than single or joint
Fact.Description: Head of household, married filing separately, and qualifying surviving spouse are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: itemized deductions
Fact.Description: Form 1 line 2e is the medical and dental amount from U.S. Schedule A, line 4. That amount is not calculated, so a return that itemizes stops. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. Incomplete until the itemizing choice is answered. Charitable gifts that are not itemized are not this stop.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: line 21 is under $24,000
Fact.Description: The tax table, No Tax Status, and the Limited Income Credit are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. Incomplete until line 21 is complete, which waits on rent and the W-2 amounts.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: line 21 is over $1,000,000
Fact.Description: The 4 percent surtax on line 28b is not calculated. The 2026 indexed threshold is not pinned, so the stop is the statutory $1,000,000 with margin. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: federal earned income credit
Fact.Description: The Massachusetts earned income credit is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Massachusetts use tax
Fact.Description: Line 34 is not calculated. Yes stops the return. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. Incomplete until the question is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: no full-year minimum creditable coverage
Fact.Description: Schedule HC penalty worksheet is not calculated. No, for the filer or for the spouse on a joint return, stops the return. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. A single return does not wait on the spouse.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Massachusetts retirement contribution in box 14
Fact.Description: A box 14 retirement contribution would change lines 11a and 11b. Yes stops the return. Complete false when this is not a Massachusetts return. Incomplete until the question is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Schedule HC insurer and subscriber number
Fact.Description: Incomplete until the Form MA 1099-HC insurer name and subscriber number are entered, and on a joint return until the spouse's are entered. Complete false once they are entered, and when this is not a Massachusetts return. Schedule HC is enclosed with every supported resident Form 1.
